title: FlightFile
description:
`flight.yaml`: the pack's Flight pages and its flight fields, in order. The pack gives
content and grouping only; the app decides how every part looks.

fields.description: Every flight field, in order: the order rows and strip parts follow.

overview.description:
The Overview page's "This flight" rows. Without them, one row per Flight page that
has fields: its title, its first two values and its sub-line.

pages.description:
The Flight pages' titles and cards. Without them, each page the fields name holds
them, in cards titled by their `group`.

Calculation.description:
A field's value worked out from other fields, as one of the app's calculations
(decision 0033): exactly one of `sum`, `scale` or `isa_temperature`. A pack chooses among
them but cannot add one.

isa_temperature.description:
The standard atmosphere's temperature at a flight level, plus a deviation, in whole
degrees Celsius: 15 °C at sea level, falling 1.98 °C per 1,000 ft, down to −56.5 °C
from 36,089 ft.

scale.description:
One number field divided by `scale` and rounded to a multiple of `step`, by
`display`'s rules (fuel in thousands, rounded up to a tenth).

sum.description:
Two or more number fields added together, which share a unit field. The result keeps
the most decimals any of them has (126.5 + 12.4 = 138.9).

FieldAlso.description:
A read-only copy of a field on another page and group, with a link to the field's own
page, e.g. the runway on the Takeoff page.

description.description: The row's description there; the field's own otherwise.

group.description: The card on that page the copy shows in, by its title.

label.description: The row's label there; the field's own label otherwise.

ofp.description: The side panel's parts for the copy, over the field's own panel.

page.description: The Flight page the copy shows on, e.g. `takeoff`.

FieldChoice.description: One choice of a choice field, with the text shown for it when it differs from the value.

label.description: The text shown for it; the value otherwise.

value.description: The value stored when it is chosen.

FieldDisplay.description:
How a number from a plan is stored: divided by `scale` (1000 for thousands, as the CDU
takes a weight), then rounded to a multiple of `step` (0.1 keeps one decimal).

round.description: Which way the scaled number is rounded to `step`.

scale.description: What the plan's number is divided by before it is stored, e.g. 1000.

step.description: The multiple the scaled number is rounded to, e.g. 0.1 for one decimal.

FieldInput.description:
The box a value is typed in. Every part is optional: without them, the box takes text of
any length, or numbers for a number field, and shows no placeholder beyond the app's.

max_length.description: The most characters the box takes.

mode.description:
What the box takes: it picks the keyboard a phone shows, and a number mode stores the
value without a leading "FL" or any "°", "%", "+", comma or space typed with it.

placeholder.description: What the empty box says, e.g. "From the FMC".

oneOf.description: A number, with ranges per unit when it has a `unit`.

FieldOfp.description:
The side panel beside a selected row: where the flight plan (the OFP) prints the value.
The app has a panel for each SimBrief source it reads; these parts change it. A field
with no source and no panel of its own takes its page's, or the app's "not in the plan"
panel.

body.description: The text under the heading, in place of the app's.

from.description: Show where the plan prints this source (the plan's close-up of it).

not_in_plan.description:
The value is not set from the plan (a clearance, a value from the aircraft's own
computer), which the panel says.

note.description: The note under the plan's close-up, in place of the app's.

outline.description: The panel shows the plan's page outline; false shows the close-up alone.

title.description: The panel's heading, in place of the app's.

FieldRange.description:
The range a number may take, in one unit (a value of the field's `unit` field), or in
every unit when `unit` is left out. Stored values are checked, so a weight stored in
thousands has its range in thousands.

max.description: The highest value in range; the Flight pages flag a value above it.

message.description:
What the Flight pages say under a value outside the range, e.g. "Enter FL100 to
FL410"; `{unit}` is the flight's unit in lower case. Without it, "Enter {min} to
{max}", in the values as the page shows them.

min.description: The lowest value in range; the Flight pages flag a value below it.

unit.description:
The unit this range is for: a value of the field's `unit` field, e.g. `KG`. Left
out, the range holds in every unit.

FieldShow.description:
How a value reads on the Flight pages: `prefix`, the value, `suffix` ("FL" 360, 24.5
"%"), with thousands grouped (18,000) or a plus sign on a positive number (+2). Content
only: the app decides how it looks.

grouped.description: Show a number with its thousands grouped (18,000). Takes the place of `signed`.

prefix.description: Text shown before the value, e.g. "FL".

signed.description: Show a plus sign before a positive number (+2).

suffix.description: Text shown after the value, e.g. "%".

calculated.description:
Worked out from other fields each time the flight is read, never stored or typed
(decision 0033). A calculated field has no `simbrief`, `input` or `display`.

choices.description: For a choice field: its values, in order.

description.description: The text under the row's name.

display.description: How a number from a plan is stored.

group.description:
The card on its page it shows in: a `pages` card by its title, or, without `pages`,
the title of the card it makes.

id.description:
Lower-case letters, digits and underscores, e.g. `zfw`. Steps name it in `fill`,
`hint` and CDU text, and saved flights key its value by it.

input.description: The Flight pages' box for it.

kind.description: What it holds: a number, any text, or one of its `choices`.

label.description: The row's name on the Flight pages.

location.description: Where the value goes in the aircraft, e.g. "Enter on the CDU › PERF INIT".

needed.description: Counted in "N to enter" though no step fills it; a field a step fills always is.

ofp.description: The side panel's parts for its row.

page.description: The Flight page and group it shows in.

phase.description: The phase that uses it, linked from its row ("Before start ›").

ranges.description:
For a number: the values in range, per unit or for every unit. A value outside is
flagged on the Flight pages.

read_only.description: Shown on its page but not typed there.

show.description: How its value reads on the Flight pages.

show_in.description: Where else its value shows: the flight strip, the Arrival data box.

simbrief.description:
The plan values that fill it. More than one are added together (reserve fuel and
alternate fuel, for the FMC's reserves). A read-only source (air distance, en route
time, trip fuel, taxi fuel) is shown from the plan and never stored.

spoken.description:
What a link or a second box calls it ("V1", "runway heading"); its id, in words,
otherwise.

strip.description: How it reads in the flight strip, when `show_in` names the strip.

suggested_by.description: An option whose suggestion (decision 0027) the row shows as its value.

toggle.description: A choice field of two choices shown under its description (minimums: BARO or RADIO).

unit.description:
For a number: the choice field that holds its unit (`weight_unit`), whose values its
`ranges` name.

with.description: A second field typed in the same row (cargo, beside passengers).

FlightGroup.description:
One titled card of a Flight page. Its rows are the fields naming this page and group,
in `flight.yaml`'s order.

fields.description:
The order of its rows, by field id (a field naming this page and group, or a copy
`also` places here); fields not listed follow in `flight.yaml`'s order.

note.description: A short note in the card's header, e.g. "Same unit as fuel".

notes.description: The flight's notes from ATC, as the card's last row.

title.description: The card's title. Fields name it as their `group`, and `also` copies as theirs.

units.description: A unit toggle in the card's header.

FlightOverviewRow.description:
A "This flight" row on the Overview page, linking to a Flight page by its title. `value`
and `description` are parts written with `{field}` for a field's value as typed,
`{field:grouped}` for a number with its thousands grouped, and `{unit}` for the flight's
unit. A part shows when any field it names has a value, its other fields reading "—";
value parts join with " · ", description parts with a space.

description.description: The text under the value, as parts joined with a space.

empty.description: The description when no description part shows.

page.description: The Flight page the row links to.

value.description: The row's value, as parts joined with " · ".

FlightPage.description:
One Flight page: one of the app's (`route`, `fuel`, `cruise`, `clearance`, `takeoff`,
`approach`), with its title, sub-line and cards. Without `pages`, the app's own page
names hold every field, each card titled by the fields' `group`.

groups.description: The page's cards, in order. A card with no rows is left out.

id.description: Which of the app's Flight pages this is; fields name it as their `page`.

ofp.description: The side panel for the page's fields with no source and no panel of their own.

selected.description: The field selected when the page opens; its first otherwise.

GroupUnits.description:
A field whose group toggles a unit: the choice field it sets, and the words before the
toggle ("Weights in"); the field's label otherwise.

field.description: The id of the choice field the toggle sets, e.g. `weight_unit`.

label.description: The words before the toggle; the field's label otherwise.

InputMode.description: How a value is typed on the Flight pages.

IsaTemperature.description: `isa_temperature`: the fields holding the flight level and the ISA deviation.

deviation.description: The number field holding the deviation from standard, in degrees Celsius.

level.description: The number field holding the flight level, e.g. `cruise_level` (350 for FL350).

NotesRow.description: The flight's notes from ATC, as a row of a group: its label and description.

Rounding.description: Which way a value is rounded to its `step`.

oneOf.description: To the next multiple of `step` up.
To the next multiple of `step` down.

ScaleCalculation.description: `scale`: a number field, divided and rounded.

field.description: The number field it divides, e.g. `fuel`.

round.description: Which way the result is rounded to `step`.

scale.description: What the number is divided by, e.g. 1000.

step.description: The multiple the result is rounded to, e.g. 0.1 for one decimal.

ShowIn.description: Where else a field's value shows, besides the Flight pages.

oneOf.description: The flight strip's summary, in the pack's order.

SimbriefSource.description:
A value the app reads from a SimBrief plan. The list is the app's: it describes SimBrief,
so a pack chooses among these sources but cannot add one.

oneOf.description: Airline code and flight number, at most seven characters.
Block (ramp) fuel, in the plan's unit.
Reserve fuel, in the plan's unit.
Alternate fuel, in the plan's unit.
Minimum takeoff fuel, in the plan's unit.
Zero fuel weight, in the plan's unit.
Planned takeoff weight, in the plan's unit.
The departure's transition altitude, in feet.
The destination's transition level, as a flight level.
The departure's altimeter setting, from its METAR.
The destination's altimeter setting, from its METAR, in the departure's unit.
The departure airport's position, latitude and longitude.

The AIRAC cycle's dates: when it takes effect and when the next one does, as
`2025-10-30/2025-11-27`.
The planned time out of the gate, in UTC, as `10:00`.
The planned date out of the gate, in UTC, as `2025-11-13`.
The planned time en route, read-only.

StripText.description:
How a field's value reads in the flight strip: `prefix`, the value, `suffix`. A field with
`join` follows the strip part before it, after that text (the destination after the
departure with " → ", a transition after its SID with ".").

join.description:
The text that joins this value to the strip part before it (" → ", "."); without it,
the value starts a part of its own.

prefix.description: Text written before the value, e.g. "FL".
